verdict.rationale: Alloy publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document and a publicly browsable reference of 134 endpoint pages with a Try It panel and SDK snippets. The API is versioned under /v1 with inline deprecation notices, and documented endpoints include the Events API, the Evaluation API and a /healthcheck. Together these let a user or agent drive the product programmatically against sandbox or production bases. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a public API changelog or deprecation-policy page (the OpenAPI file is also not linked from the docs UI).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Alloy serves its complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 document at the docs origin (servers sandbox.alloy.co/v1 and api.alloy.co/v1).
The ReadMe-hosted API reference (134 endpoint pages, publicly browsable) runs the "Try It!" request panel with SDK snippets enabled
Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.
Alloy provides a /healthcheck endpoint that confirms basic API connectivity.
